GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 123 (29 Oct 45) GC
(SCAPIN-206)
29 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Monetary Restrictions.
1. Reference is made to your N.D. No. 214 dated 24 October 1945.
2. All overseas commanders have been notified of the maximum amounts of Yen Currency that returning Japanese Nationals will be permitted to bring to Japan.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
